Name: (CP) Cute Valley - Purple
Author: BeneathThePlass
Description:
This is a white and purple recolor/retexture of the [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/content-patcher-cute-valley-1-3-beta.110882/]Cute Valley - Pink mod[/url], made by [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/rosalie.518048/]Rosalie [/url]on the Chucklefish forums ([i]now also posted [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3503]here on Nexus[/url][/i]). This recolors everything included in the original mod, so you have all of the major farm buildings, the craftables, the tools, the weapons, and the furniture that Rosalie created- now in purple! Everything can be toggled on or off as well, if you've installed the fabulous [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]!

[b]Installation: [/b]
[b]1.[/b] Make sure that you have both [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] correctly installed in your Stardew Valley folder.
[b]2.[/b] Unzip the '[CP] More Buildings for Cute Valley Blue' folder and drop it into your 'Mods' folder in the main SDV game folder.
[b]3. [/b]Congrats, you're done and ready to go! Enjoy your new farm!

[b]Credit:[/b] ALL credit, of course, to [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/members/rosalie.518048/]Rosalie[/url], as they created the original [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/content-patcher-cute-valley-1-3-beta.110882/]Cute Valley - Pink mod[/url] that this mod recolors!
